notes: All 88 numbered products are retained. Seven AC indoor/outdoor pairs are one customer product each; both exact component taxonomy paths are retained.
LG IDs come directly from the workbook. Four source #N/A classifications remain unmapped.
Lifestyle displays remain in TV and use the style facet.
Representative model specifications were verified against exact LG manufacturer pages. Other missing specifications remain blank.

Model LBB33BLGA has a source annotation InstaView in Product level P4, but the verified manufacturer page describes a 335L glass-door refrigerator. That annotation is preserved only in source data and is not promoted as a feature.
